# Bank Statement Parsing Benchmark samples

Five synthetic, generic bank statements (`bsb-00N.pdf`) and their metadata (`bsb-00N.json`) from
the Bank Statement Parsing Benchmark:
https://github.com/bankstatemently/bank-statement-parsing-benchmark

They are vendored unchanged and used only to test kalan's locale-aware date and amount helpers on
layouts from other countries (Singapore, US, Netherlands, Hong Kong, Canada). All people, accounts
and numbers in them are synthetic, as published by the benchmark.
